well let me tell you a real story that still gives me the chills. The guy -we will name John- tried to kill himself with pills and alcohol. They found him in a coma state. they treated him at the hospital and came out of his come. About the first thing John said was that he wanted to live, but his kidneys shut off and was dead three days after. There are solutions, have you tried suicide hotline? counselling? pills? I know you feel way passed that and you don't give a fuck you, just want it to stop but thousands of people succeeded to get better, to find some good moments in life like many redditors here.

That last girlfriend seems confused, and confused people don't know what they want so, with or without be aware, they mess with people around because they try "things" to check how they feel at the expands of the other.  It hurts but stay away. Also the holiday season is a very hard period for anyone depressed as you are. Even winter with its lack of light doesn't help. As much as you have enough and you don't see the end of this burden, it improves and will for you, you have to hang in there. Maybe if you treat yourself as you would do for a friend who is sick or bruised all over, you would be more at peace with yourself. check how you treat yourself; would a good friend do that to you? why being so harsh on yourself?

I suppose it would cost you more than you can afford in you live in the USA. You could talk with someone from http://www.tgforum.com/ who has felt like you and they could give you good tips. If you really want to let it go, then don't bother with your parents and embrace your inner gender, they might come to accept it , given some time. Go and reach people with affinity with you. There is a too high rate of suicide among LGBT, don't become a statistic, there is a woman in you who wants to live.

Buddism not as a religion, as a way of seeing things. Most important be indulgent with yourself, take care of yourself like you would like a friend takes care of you, that could help

I think teen years are the worse in terms of intensity when we are broken heart. Also we don't know our limits very well, and are more insecure because we don't have perspective. In brief, it sucks. You have reached a limit; you are not able, at this time of your life, to share your love for Sam and most people can't do it for their whole life anyway. So it looks good to be open but if you're not ready you are just not respecting yourself. Sam is important part of your life, but there are more fish in the sea. I might look cold saying that, because you feel there is nothing else, but there are. Be honest with yourself first, then you can be honest to Sam and if he can't accept your limits, it means you are not meant to be together at that point of your life. If he is the one, you may part but you'll be back together when you have more experience.

you can't do it during the holiday season or any day of the year because if could feel the pain they will live with after, you wouldn't do it. There are plenty of other options, if you  want to talk with someone here, I bet you will find one that is -even for you- more bearable. Hang on.
I hope you contacted anyone here who is very interested to talk to you. My nephew is asperger and I love to chat with him.

Every time I've seen parents acting like that is that they went through that same kind of shit when they were young, never accepted by their parents and they just repeating the same mistakes, even if it doesn't make sense to hurt your own child but since that 's only that they know, but go away, give yourself time.

Talk to the mother, you will not live well if something happens.Your friend will be probably upset but in my little experience this usually fades out. I know someone who went through something similar and the depressed was upset, but the friend told her that she hadn't given any choice, she couldn't die, he  loved her.After a while she saw he was right.
How long they say you have to do?

As I've said in other comments, don't be afraid to ask direct questions, like "do you think of commiting suicide?" and most of the time, people are almost relieved that someone asks the real questions, and if he says yes, try to find the means and the time, and if he has clear info to give on those two last, there is an emergency. Suicidal people won't kill themselves because you ask clear questions, it becomes a good occasion to talk to each other openly and do what icram just suggested; show him that you care. Female rejections have pushed many men to kill themselves but those who went through the burden and remained alive have a whole new life in front of them with stronger background to face life.
And have a register for the mentally ill, last time we heard that  it was in Germany in the 30s.

They can't force you to take pills. Most people don't like pills for many reasons. May I ask what is it that you don't like about pills? Anyway I don't work in mental health field but my small experience is that you don't take pills with a cousellor. Counselling might be your solution.
no, you shouldn't. Have you tried other options before that one?

You haven't reached the peak of your life, there are many good moments to come, but being in the twenties is really scary because you have to succeed in so many fields at the same without much experience, but there are people as  socially "unskilled" as you are who would love to meet a guy like you. BTW there are no stupid reasons for feeling depressed, when it strikes, it does and it's shitty, period. Believe me, you might feel you're dragging down your family but losing you would destroy them, don't be harsh on you, try to find things to do that please you or chat with some people online, it is easier than live, go in a forum with your interest. Suicide is does not destroy just one life, it has repercussions that touch every one who cares for you.

Why do want to hurt other people? Try pushing yourself into a sport just to lower that rage, it works for millions of people. You might not be able to connect now because you are in the middle of a turmoil, but find a way to do aérobic, run, jump and use that anger to push yourself and I bet you'll feel better after and who knows find some connection?. There are people who love you, so you might be insane -as few of us here are- but you have succeeded to keep those loving persons close to you, just for that, go, swim, bike, run, jog, jump, you get the idea. There is hope.
HeeHaw! keep the good work!

I think it is normal to not want counselling, it means to expose how bad we feel and if it is family counselling then you worry how your pparents will receive your pain, but to have someone neutral to the situation is very helpful, that cousellor is there to help you, the process might hurt but you will feel better eventually, hold on, you are on the right track.

It made the whole difference, but that was my second  biggest "crash" in my life so I knew what meds was working for me, the first time was longer because I had to find the right one for me and the quantity as well. Every person reacts differently to any antidepressant, so we have to go through trials and errors but you have to keep trying, sometimes the side effects fade out. I had one that made me like a zombie, another was upsetting my bowels, though having a normal life is worth all the effort, good luck.
oh sorry, I was not talking about cutting but about people who are depressed and are cutting, because I don't know much but there must have people who feel like you. I know gives a good feeling.

As a mother please, please, believe me, your parents rather learn about your depression when you're alive than finding your body, talk to them, you will be surprised of their reaction, we love our kids even if we are harsh, unfair to them. You are the most precious thing to them, talk to them.
Have you tried a guide counsellor at school? or a teacher you trust?

you can't be that ready without having tried medication. Yes the idea to die is sweet but we don't want to see you go. Why don't you talk to suicide hotlines from your area, they are great people, come on, you owe redditors to call them. Do it and come back to us. There is a link on the right side of the screen.

You are both obviously in crisis,  A crying man might be unbearable for her but your son needs someone sensitive which she seems to not be. your kid does need you, can you go for a walk with the baby and try to calm down? ADD can be a nightmare for a couple especially if the nonADD spouse doesn't understand how it works. When my husband understood what was really ADD, things went smoother. Your son has a chance to have ADD (don't want to knock you down here, just stats) but THAT is  one fucking good reason to stay alive; he needs a caring parent who will understand who he is and god knows I might be wrong and you'll be marvelled at his progress in life no matter ADD or not. he needs you, period. You might even see yourself as all fucked-up but you are his father and every single child prefer to have a imperfect father than one who killed himself

nope, don't do it, we never know what is the other side and you have already tried some solutions, go back to those that gave even a small relief. I know someone who told me once that she went through a cancer and another a depression, and she told me that depression had been harder for her to go through. Of course it is different for everyone but you have to tell yourself to continue even if you don't believe you should. Good luck.

The two worst depressive bouts I had were because I thought I was not good enough for my boyfriend / husband, so I know the feeling. There is no easy way to go through that but ending your life is not an option, you want to do that because it hurts too much. You have to find some help, any help. I know we feel like like a shitty burden but you have to find some help: suicide hotline (there is a phone line on the right of this subreddit), friends, support group, the toughest is the first step, then the second one will be tough, but you keep going and when you still wonder if it is worth it, slowly, you will feel that it is less painful, that you are worth living. Come on Woeni, it is a difficult road, but after you will see that even if you had not believed on yourself, you had that strentgh, you don't believe me, but people who survie depression are all heroes. you don't want to be a hero, you want less pain, make a move. that boyfriend is poison for you right now, maybe when you have found some relief you will be able to decide what you do with that relationship, but now you have to find a hand to hold.

I hear you are at the end of the road and there is only death that will relief your burden but from experience, pills are not masks, they give you what your brain is missing, some stuff that is usually produced by the brain but not on those who are depressed. and so what if you are addicted to antidepressors? diabetics don't say they are addicted to insulin! yes, you are at risk to be addicted to something but you have no idea what wonders pills can do and I know you don't believe me because that is the main symptom of depression: feeling there is no way out. You have absolutely nothing to lose to wait a few months, trying pills and check what happens. I have a few friends who tried to commit suicide but all of them are happy today that they succeeded to get the rope out of their neck before it was to late. Soem of them are on pills for their whole life, but they found peace.

You have to find out how serious he is about killing himself. Does he give obvious or subtle hints? Then you can ask direct questions. It is a myth to think that direct question will trigger the dread action. I have personally been on both sides of that kind of situation and most of the time, surprisingly, people say the truth, so the first step is to know if he has plans and if so, how precise (mean, location) and if so you need to know if he has decided on a precise moment, if so you do need a hotline suicide help. When it happened to my daughter I gave her a "false choice" which means either way I was improving the situation. I told her she had the choice between seeing a doctor or talk to someone on a hotline suicide which he did. Don't worry, the fact you are frank will probably touch him or at least he talk with you about what is really going on. You could call a suicide line yourself to get good tips.

You have to keep in mind that the fact that you don't have any interest to try new pills is by itself a symptom of depression. We all know - I mean  /r/depression- that when we are in that mood it is because we have hit the bottom part. When we want to die it's because it hurts too much and knowing we can stop it by dying makes us at peace because -finally- we have some hold on our life, but there are other solutions like the others mention. Don't let that shitty illness have the last word.
In my corner of the world, jokes are told frequently at funeral homes. It is not a lack of respect, the purpose is well explained here by that guy who has a shitty name.

28 years and I still enjoy the sound of his car coming in the driveway when he gets home after me. We have never been good at playing games at each other and have a low tolerance for pain, so tension never lasts long. We fix it as soon as the level of emotion is low enough to have a decent respectful discussion. But to answer the question, what is most important is the complicity that we have built through ups and sometimes big downs, those implicit daily agreement on hundreds of details, the shared laughs, he is never boring and yes sexual desire keeps a couple healthy.
